title: MRM PAM4 transmitter, TDECQ (53 GBd)
description: Microring modulator driven by a PAM4 PRBS source at 53.125 GBd into a matched optical termination; the Eye tab scores IEEE TDECQ (stateye) raw and through the reference FFE

notes.title: 53.125 GBd PAM4 microring transmitter, scored by TDECQ
lines: PRBS1 (mode pam4) drives RING1's electrode through a 50 ohm driver
resistance RD1: four drive levels 0 / 0.6 / 1.2 / 1.8 V step the
resonance by 45 pm/V, and LAS1 parked -33 pm off resonance turns that
into four optical levels at popt. The through port ends in a matched
optical termination (OT1): TDECQ is an optical transmitter metric, so
popt itself is what gets scored -- no photodiode needed.
Run, then open the Eye tab (trace popt) and press Measure in the
stateye row: IEEE TDECQ through the reference receiver and FFE, with
the simulated eye and stateye's equalized eye side by side. The Link
TDECQ proper uses OMA_outer (runs of 7 threes / 6 zeros: a full
PRBS-13Q, 8191 UI). The canvas caps a transient at 20,000 points, so
this 800 UI record reports TDECQ on the crossing-point OMA and says so.
For the reportable number run  examples/mrm_pam4_tdecq.py  (full
PRBS-13Q, ~40 s; --rlm pre-distorts the levels for the ring's
Lorentzian and improves both RLM and TDECQ).
